Cliopatria draws the Dominican Republic as Spanish Empire land 1861-1865 and as United States land 1916-1923; the DR dossier treats the first as annexation then restoration (loss, contest, gain with spanish-empire) and the second as an occupation (occupation_start/end with united-states-of-america); the Spanish Empire and United States dossiers should agree.

Los Altos: Cliopatria's 1840-1841 row is mis-dated (state 1838-1840 and 1848-1849); the Guatemala dossier dates the 1840 reincorporation to January (infobox) while the Los Altos dossier uses April (page body, 2 April 1840).

Republic of the Rio Grande 1840-1841 is cut to 1840 (surrender 6 November 1840) and is a claim of three states, not held land; counterparts used are federated-republic-of-mexico (found) and centralist-mexico (loss), as the two Mexican dossiers split the 1840 land.

El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua start in 1839/4, 1838/11, 1838/4 (one year or more before Cliopatria's 1840); the dossiers add 1838-1839 keyframes. El Salvador's start is a choice (declaration of independence was 30 Jan 1841).
Nicaragua's Honduras events (contest 1869-1960, loss 1960) mirror the Honduras dossier but move no cell of Nicaragua's Cliopatria outline.
The haiti dossier ends in 1935 and republic-of-haiti begins in 1936; the Dominican Republic's 1936 frontier loss uses republic-of-haiti.
